correctness.rationale: For q even, the projective-plane incidence axioms yield BB^T=B^TB=J in F2 and Bu=B^Tu=u. The toggled C=B+ef^T has rank rho+1 because e is not in im(B), f is not in im(B^T), and the rank-one update supplies e to im(C). P=CC^T and Q=C^TC have exactly three-dimensional images spanned by u,b,e and u,c,f, so rank(A^2)=6. For deletion delta=e^Tb=1, the restrictions collapse to a one-dimensional w, with P^2=ww^T nonzero, P^3=0, and the bipartite A^3,A^4,A^5 ranks 4,2,0. For insertion delta=0, P and Q restrict to 3x3 matrices with irreducible F2 characteristic polynomial t^3+t+1 of order 7. A interchanges the two invertible three-dimensional summands; A^7 swaps them, giving 2^3=8 states fixed by A^7, exactly a fixed state plus one 7-cycle; the 56 others form four 14-cycles. Kernel dimensions deliver all first-entry and phase-basin formulas. These algebraic identities apply to non-Desarguesian planes too. Independently rebuilt the Fano incidence and checked all 49 possible toggles (21 deletions, 28 insertions), their power ranks and 7/14-period structure. Finite checks are corroborative, not the universal proof.

final_claim: For any finite projective plane of even order q>=2, deletion of a point-line incidence makes synchronous open-neighborhood binary XOR nilpotent of index exactly five with ranks (2v,2rho+2,6,4,2,0); insertion yields a 64-state eventual periodic space containing one fixed point, one seven-cycle and four fourteen-cycles, reached within two updates with exact rank-dependent basin counts.
limitations: Only actual existing even-order projective planes, single toggle and synchronous binary open-neighborhood XOR; q need not be a prime power in the proof.
Incidence 2-rank rho remains dependent on the plane; no universal rho formula is asserted.
